headers.title: Headers
headers.text: The site as Referer on every picture, which the Keyoapp CDN checks.

getPopular.title: Popular
getPopular.text: The home page's grid of /series/ links; the theme shows one page, so later pages are empty.

getLatest.title: Latest
getLatest.text: /latest/ when the site has it, else the home page again.

search.title: Search
search.text: Reads the /series/ directory and filters it by the words here, because the theme searches in the browser.

getDetails.title: Title page
getDetails.text: The h1, the cover's CSS background image, the description paragraph, genre tags and a status word found in the page.

getChapterList.title: Chapters
getChapterList.text: The #chapters links of the title page (each /chapter/ address once), the number from the link text, the date from the span next to it.

getPageList.title: Pages
getPageList.text: The reader's images: a uid attribute becomes https://cdn.keyoapp.com/<uid>, plain src images otherwise.

helpers.title: Helpers
helpers.text: One request with the site as Referer, the card parser with covers from CSS background images, absolute addresses and the first number of a text.
